subject.title: fix(xai): derive TTS stream handshakeTimeout from caller timeoutMs

question: Should xAI TTS intentionally retain two same-budget timeout callbacks with potentially different errors, or should connectTimer remain the sole connection-deadline owner?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small, but accepting a second timeout owner changes failure semantics without demonstrating an observable improvement, so the intended compatibility contract needs an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Keep one deadline owner
options.body: Remove handshakeTimeout and retain connectTimer plus CONNECTING close as the canonical bounded and error-normalized path.

options.title: Adopt ws as the deadline owner
options.body: Replace the application connection timer with the ws handshake timeout and explicitly normalize its error while proving cleanup and caller-budget behavior.

options.title: Accept layered timers
options.body: Keep both callbacks and document and test which timeout error is allowed to win at the shared deadline.

recommendation.title: Keep one deadline owner
recommendation.body: Remove handshakeTimeout and retain connectTimer plus CONNECTING close as the canonical bounded and error-normalized path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects bundled provider failure semantics and release compatibility, making the adjacent release/provider owner the best available routing candidate.
